turns.content: Hey, I finally have a calm week again.
Nice. It sounds like things are settling down for you.
One big change is that I just started working at Google as a software engineer.
That is a big milestone. Working at Google sounds exciting.
Yeah, the onboarding has mostly been paperwork and meet-and-greets.
Early onboarding weeks usually feel like that.
I am mostly trying to learn the team names and internal tools.
That makes sense. There is usually a lot of internal vocabulary to absorb.
Actually, plans changed fast. I left Google last week and now I work at Meta on AR tools.
That is a major update. Moving from Google to Meta is a clear change.
Quick check: where do I work now?
You work at Meta on AR tools now.
I finally unpacked most of my boxes.
That always makes a move feel more real.
At first I moved to Seattle for the new apartment near Green Lake.
Seattle near Green Lake sounds like a great setup.
The neighborhood was nice, and I liked the coffee shops nearby.
That sounds like a comfortable start.
I was still figuring out transit and where to buy groceries.
Those are the details that take a little while to settle.
Small correction though: the Seattle plan fell through, so I moved to Austin instead.
Got it. Seattle was the old plan, and Austin is the current city.
Which city do I live in now?
You live in Austin now.
Our product launch meeting ran longer than expected.
Launch naming discussions can easily take longer than planned.
Earlier today the internal codename for the launch was Atlas.
Atlas is a strong codename for an internal launch.
Everyone kept using the name in the deck and the tracker.
That kind of repetition usually locks a name in.
I even updated the docs to say Atlas in the headings.
So Atlas was fully propagated through the materials.
Update from leadership: Atlas was dropped, and the current codename is Beacon.
Understood. Beacon supersedes Atlas as the active codename.
What is the current codename?
The current codename is Beacon.
My sprint planning meeting was a little chaotic today.
Those meetings can get messy when priorities keep shifting.
At the start of the week, my team lead was Jules.
Okay, Jules was your team lead earlier in the week.
Jules had been assigning the review queue and the standup order.
That sounds like Jules was clearly in the lead role.
I was used to sending blockers to Jules each morning.
That would make the reporting path pretty clear.
Leadership changed today, so Mina is my team lead now instead of Jules.
Got it. Mina replaced Jules as your team lead.
Who is my team lead now?
Your team lead is Mina now.
I finally moved my photos into a better folder structure.
Photo cleanup is tedious, but it feels good afterward.
For a while my main phone was an iPhone 15.
Okay, your main phone used to be an iPhone 15.
I had already set up all my banking apps and my transit pass on it.
That makes a phone change more annoying than it sounds.
I kept telling myself I would wait another year before switching.
That is usually the practical move.
Then I changed my mind and switched over. My main phone is a Pixel 9 now, not the iPhone 15.
Understood. The Pixel 9 replaced the iPhone 15 as your main phone.
What is my main phone now?
Your main phone is a Pixel 9 now.
Meal prep went better this week than last week.
That usually makes the whole week feel easier.
Until recently I was following a vegetarian diet.
So vegetarian was your diet before the recent change.
Most of my lunches were lentils, rice, and roasted vegetables.
That sounds consistent with a vegetarian routine.
I was trying to keep it simple and repeatable.
Repeating easy meals usually helps.
I updated my plan though. I am pescatarian now, so I am no longer vegetarian.
Got it. Pescatarian supersedes vegetarian as your current diet.
What diet am I following now?
You are following a pescatarian diet now.
The building elevator finally got fixed.
That probably makes daily life much less annoying.
Before the move, I was in apartment 5A.
Okay, 5A was your previous apartment.
I had the plants by the south window and the desk near the kitchen.
That gives me a good picture of the old place.
I was still finishing the paperwork for the larger unit upstairs.
So a move was already in progress.
The paperwork is done now, and I live in apartment 9C instead of 5A.
Understood. 9C replaced 5A as your current apartment.
Which apartment do I live in now?
You live in apartment 9C now.
I am finally getting back into a gym routine.
A stable routine makes training much easier to maintain.
Originally I was doing my workouts in the evenings after work.
So evenings were your workout time before the change.
That usually meant getting to the gym around seven.
That sounds like a typical post-work schedule.
It was okay, but the gym was crowded and I kept missing sessions.
Crowded evening sessions can be hard to stick with.
I changed the plan, and now I work out in the mornings instead of the evenings.
Got it. Morning workouts replaced evening workouts.
When do I work out now?
You work out in the mornings now.
Travel day is finally here.
Nice. Airport updates can come fast once you get to the terminal.
When I first checked the board, my flight was leaving from gate B12.
Okay, B12 was the original departure gate.
I bought a sandwich near the B concourse and sat down there.
That sounds like a reasonable place to wait if B12 was still correct.
I was half-listening for announcements while answering messages.
That is exactly when a gate change usually happens.
And it did change. The airline moved my flight from B12 to C7.
Understood. C7 supersedes B12 as the current gate.
What gate is my flight leaving from now?
Your flight is leaving from gate C7 now.
My calendar looks completely different after the reorg.
Reorgs usually reshuffle meetings immediately.
Before the reorg, my manager was Priya.
So Priya was your manager before the reorg.
Priya had been approving my roadmap draft and hiring notes.
That sounds like a standard manager relationship.
I was expecting our normal one-on-one on Friday.
That expectation makes sense if Priya was still your manager.
But the reorg closed today, and my manager is Daniel now instead of Priya.
Got it. Daniel replaced Priya as your manager.
Who is my manager now?
Your manager is Daniel now.
